description: This file defines the GroupField entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties mapped to database columns, and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: GroupField
classes.description: An entity class mapped to the 'ohrm_group_field' database table, representing a group field with properties for id, name, groupByClause, and groupFieldWidget.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the GroupField.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the GroupField.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the GroupField.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the GroupField.

methods.name: getGroupByClause
methods.description: Returns the group by clause string for the GroupField.

methods.name: setGroupByClause
methods.description: Sets the group by clause string for the GroupField.

methods.name: getGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the optional widget associated with the GroupField.

methods.name: setGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget associated with the GroupField.
